insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited (originally Apollo Munich Health Insurance Company Limited)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Legacy Apollo Munich (now HDFC ERGO) top-up product with aggregate deductible. PED waiting 48 months. Switch Benefit to indemnity plan at 10th/15th renewal or age 55-60.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity above aggregate deductible up to Sum Insured.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room rent, ICU, OT, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics.

ayush_coverage.notes: Non-allopathic treatment excluded under legacy Apollo Munich variant.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor medical/surgical hospitalisation only; donor pre/post hospitalisation excluded.

permanent_exclusions: Sleep apnoea, congenital diseases, mental disorders
notable_exclusions_summary: Legacy Apollo Munich (now HDFC ERGO) super top-up with high deductible. Comprehensive exclusion list including non-allopathic, mental illness, infertility, sleep apnoea, congenital diseases. Switch option to convert to indemnity policy at milestones.
